content: Implemented. Deleted: WELL_KNOWN_LABELER_DIDS constant + 16 hardcoded DIDs, LABELER_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECS, LABELER_QUERY_MAX_PAGES, PLC_DIRECTORY_BASE, build_known_labeler_dids, resolve_labeler_endpoint, query_labels_from_labeler, LabelerInfo struct, fetch_labeler_info_map, the 3 well_known_labeler_list_* unit tests, the 4 extract_did_from_labeler_record_uri tests + helper (will return in #182). fetch_all_labels_for_subject is now a single sqlx::query! against indexed_labels with the (uri = $1 OR uri LIKE $2 || '%') filter; rows are mapped 1:1 to NetworkContextLabel. src_display_name/src_handle are None until #183 lands. 23 network_context unit tests pass. Full backend suite pass. Frontend wasm builds clean. Net: case-view now reads exclusively from the local label index; zero AppView fan-out, zero hardcoded DIDs in source.
